items.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and adapter shape are confirmed, but the account has demonstrated paid usage.

quota.reset: monthly; exact date/account details may vary
quota.summary: Free users receive $0.10/month in inference credits; extra usage requires purchased credits. Request/token caps are not stated here.

items.name: Google AI Studio API
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and adapter shape are confirmed from primary documentation; account limits still require operator review.

quota.reset: RPD resets at midnight Pacific; other windows vary
quota.summary: Limits vary by model and project. Google exposes RPM, input TPM, and RPD; exact values must be read from AI Studio. The API key alone does not prove a free tier for a given model.

items.name: Groq API
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and current catalog IDs are confirmed from primary documentation.

quota.reset: provider headers report the applicable reset; exact values vary by model/account
quota.summary: Groq publishes model-specific free-plan examples, but exact organization limits and the first exhausted dimension must be read from response headers/account settings. The catalog avoids model IDs already scheduled for deprecation.

items.name: Cohere API
items.preflight_note: Compatibility endpoint and current model IDs are confirmed; free eligibility remains account-dependent.

quota.summary: Cohere documents an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. Cohere's Command A+ page says trial and production keys are free until rate limits are reached, while Command A publishes paid prices; verify the key's actual tier and headers before use.

items.name: OpenRouter Free Models
items.preflight_note: Read-only /models access succeeded, but the catalog was refreshed to currently listed free IDs; the existing degraded health state still requires review.

quota.reset: daily; exact reset behavior should be confirmed from account headers
quota.summary: Free models are limited to 50 requests/day without purchased credits; OpenRouter documents 1,000/day after at least $10 in credits. A no-generation /models request succeeded; exact token limits and free-route health remain account-dependent.

items.name: NVIDIA NIM
items.preflight_note: Read-only /models access succeeded for the saved key and the selected GPT-OSS model was present; generation remains quarantined until an approved smoke test.

quota.summary: NVIDIA marks several hosted endpoints as free, but exact request/token limits and access depend on the NVIDIA API key and endpoint. A no-generation /models request succeeded for the saved key; generation and free-tier headroom still require operator review.

items.name: Mistral AI
items.preflight_note: Endpoint and current model IDs are confirmed; account free eligibility remains unverified.

quota.summary: Free mode is available without a card, but current limits are shown in the Mistral Admin Panel. Completion limits are per model and organization; model pages list current API IDs and paid prices, so do not assume a free tier.

items.name: FreeInference
items.preflight_note: Official documentation confirms an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and free coding models; the account key and current access still require operator smoke testing.

quota.summary: FreeInference documents free access for coding agents and lists glm-5.1, minimax-m2.5, minimax-m3, qwen3.6-35b, diffusiongemma, and deepseek-v4-flash as free models. The authenticated /v1/models response is the source of truth for each account.

items.name: LLM7.io
items.preflight_note: Official documentation confirms the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, free token access, and the default model selector; the supplied account key still requires a live smoke test.

quota.summary: LLM7 documents a free tier and recommends the `default` selector, which routes to an available free model. Its limits documentation lists 2 requests/second, 20/minute, and 100/hour for free tokens; use conservative local limits until the live key's headers confirm current quotas.

items.name: Aion Labs
items.preflight_note: Endpoint, model IDs, and documented model-list envelope are confirmed.

quota.reset: daily token limit; exact reset time is provider-defined
quota.summary: The default free tier documents 15 RPM, 20,000 tokens/minute, and 20,000 tokens/day. The API is OpenAI-compatible; no credit card is required for the free tier according to the provider pricing page. Roleplay/storytelling specialization is provider-described, not independently benchmarked.

items.name: Kilo Gateway
items.preflight_note: Read-only /models access succeeded and the current catalog exposes free models; generation remains quarantined until an approved smoke test.

quota.reset: IP-based anonymous limit is hourly; model/account limits vary
quota.summary: Kilo documents unauthenticated access for free models with a 200 requests/hour/IP limit. A current no-generation /models request succeeded; the selected free IDs are live now, but availability and generation quality still require review.

items.name: Ollama Cloud
items.preflight_note: Cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoint is documented; account/model limits remain qualitative.

quota.reset: session limits reset every 5 hours; weekly limits reset every 7 days
quota.summary: Ollama's Free plan includes cloud-model access with light usage. Limits are not a fixed token number: usage depends on input, cached input, output, and model compute weight. The provider documents a 5-hour session window and 7-day weekly window; exact allowances are account/model dependent.

items.name: BazaarLink
items.preflight_note: Read-only /models access succeeded; auto:free and the current free DeepSeek route are present. Generation remains quarantined until an approved smoke test.

quota.reset: RPM is rolling; daily usage is unlimited subject to free quota/credits
quota.summary: BazaarLink documents a free tier of 10 RPM and 150 requests/day for accounts without credit, plus an auto:free route. A no-generation /models request succeeded and exposed auto:free plus the current `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash:free` route; paid fallback remains disabled.

items.name: Grok Build
items.preflight_note: Native coding-agent candidate only. Requires an operator-installed, authenticated CLI and an explicit wrapper; no automated activation or browser automation is configured.
